select re.record_id, re.patient_id, re.research_id, re.follow_id, re.name, re.stage_num, re.stage_add_num, re.question_status, re.warn_status, re.over_time_status, re.over_time_handle_status, re.update_by, re.create_by, re.create_time, re.update_time, re.fill_time, re.visit_time, re.lock_visit_time, re.edc_status, i.patient_name, i.patient_code, te.follow_name, re.follow_opinion, re.follow_status, re.form_complent_rate from patient_record re inner join patient_info i on re.patient_id = i.patient_id left join patient_record_template te on re.follow_id = te.follow_id

mapper.select: select r.research_id, r.follow_status, r.warn_status, r.over_time_status FROM patient_record r INNER JOIN patient_info p on p.patient_id = r.patient_id INNER JOIN patient_record_template prt on prt.follow_id = r.follow_id where prt.follow_num > 0 and p.research_id not in (select DISTINCT(q.research_id) from quit_record q where q.is_agree = 1 and q.research_id = p.research_id and q.person_id = p.person_id)
where record_id = #{recordId}

select pi.patient_id, pi.research_id, pi.enrollment_time, c.follow_id, c.stage_num, c.record_id, c.lock_visit_time, c.stage_add_num from patient_info pi left join (select pr.record_id, pr.follow_id, pr.patient_id, pr.research_id, pr.stage_num, pr.lock_visit_time, pr.stage_add_num from patient_record pr, (select MAX(r.record_id) as new_record_id from patient_record r where r.research_id = #{researchId} and TO_DAYS(r.lock_visit_time) = TO_DAYS(#{handleDate}) group by r.patient_id) pd where pr.record_id = pd.new_record_id) c on c.patient_id = c.patient_id where pi.research_id = #{researchId} and pi.enrollment_status = '1'

select pi.patient_id, pi.research_id, pi.enrollment_time, c.follow_id, c.stage_num, c.record_id, c.lock_visit_time from patient_info pi left join (select pr.record_id, pr.follow_id, pr.patient_id, pr.research_id, pr.stage_num, pr.lock_visit_time from patient_record pr, (select MAX(r.record_id) as new_record_id from patient_record r where r.research_id = #{researchId} and date_format(r.lock_visit_time, '%y-%m') <= date_format(#{handleDate}, '%y-%m') group by r.patient_id) pd where pr.record_id = pd.new_record_id) c on c.patient_id = pi.patient_id where pi.research_id = #{researchId} and pi.enrollment_status = '1'

select distinct pr.patient_id from patient_record pr where pr.research_id = #{researchId} and exists (select 1 from patient_record pr2 where pr.patient_id = pr2.patient_id and `name` != '基线' and follow_status = 3) and not exists (select 1 from patient_record pr2 where pr.patient_id = pr2.patient_id and `name` != '基线' and follow_status != 3)

select pr.record_id, pr.follow_id, pr.patient_id, pr.research_id, pr.stage_num, pr.stage_add_num, pr.lock_visit_time, pi.account_id from patient_record pr, patient_info pi, mp_person mp, (select MAX(r.record_id) as new_record_id from patient_record r where r.research_id = #{researchId} group by r.patient_id) pd, research_info ri where pr.record_id = pd.new_record_id and ri.id = pr.research_id and pi.patient_id = pr.patient_id and mp.person_id = pi.person_id and pr.research_id = #{researchId} and pi.enrollment_status = '1' and pi.is_end_create_record = '0' and pi.account_id > 0 and pi.person_id not in (select q.person_id from quit_record q where q.is_agree = 1 and pi.research_id = q.research_id and q.person_id = pi.person_id)

select pr.record_id, pr.follow_id, pr.patient_id, pr.research_id, pr.stage_num, pr.stage_add_num, pr.lock_visit_time, pi.account_id from patient_record pr, patient_info pi, (select MAX(r.record_id) as new_record_id from patient_record r where r.research_id = #{researchId} group by r.patient_id) pd, research_info ri where pr.record_id = pd.new_record_id and ri.id = pr.research_id and pi.patient_id = pr.patient_id and pr.research_id = #{researchId} and pi.enrollment_status = '1' and pi.account_id > 0 and pi.person_id not in (select q.person_id from quit_record q where q.is_agree = 1 and pi.research_id = q.research_id)
